meta.name: version-bump
meta.description: Automated semantic versioning and release workflow for Claude Code plugins. Handles version increments across package.json, marketplace.json, plugin.json manifests, build verification, git tagging, GitHub releases, and changelog generation. NPM publishing is the final human-required handoff because the maintainer raised npm security.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动完成版本号递增、构建校验、git 标签与发布说明生成
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果每次发版都要手动改版本号、打标签、写发布说明。
copy.tagline_en: Automate version bumps, build checks, git tags, and changelog generation
copy.fit_line_en: For you if every release means manually editing versions, tagging, and writing release notes.

howto.what: 当你要求发布插件新版本，它会自动更新所有清单中的版本号、运行构建与同步、提交并推送代码、打 git 标签、创建 GitHub release、重写 CHANGELOG，最后把 npm 发布留给你手动完成。
howto.when: 当你要求为 Claude 插件发布新版本或提升版本号时触发；它会先判断改动属于补丁、新功能还是破坏性变更，再按流程执行。

say.text: 帮我发个补丁版本，修复了登录崩溃。
say.note: 按补丁流程跑，最后等你手动 npm publish。

say.text: 升级到 1.3.0 并发布，加了文件同步功能。
say.note: 它会更新所有清单、推送并创建 GitHub release。

say.text: 发布一个不兼容旧版的 2.0.0。
say.note: 按破坏性变更处理，提醒你人工发布 npm。

howto.what_en: When you ask to publish a new plugin version, it automatically bumps the version in every manifest, runs build and sync, commits and pushes the code, tags a git tag, creates a GitHub release, rewrites CHANGELOG, and finally leaves npm publishing for you to run manually.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to publish a new plugin version or bump the version number; it first decides whether the change is a patch, minor, or major, then proceeds.

say_en.text: Publish a patch release fixing the login crash.
say_en.note: It runs the patch flow and leaves npm publish to you.

say_en.text: Upgrade to 1.3.0 and publish, adding file sync.
say_en.note: It bumps all manifests, pushes, and creates a GitHub release.
Treats as major and reminds you to publish npm manually.
